faqs.q: When should I complete a letter of authority?
faqs.a: You may need a letter of authority if you want to nominate someone within your business who is not listed as an associate on the ABR to act on behalf of your business, or if you want your accountant, tax agent, or BAS agent to act on your behalf.

faqs.q: What information should I include in the letter of authority?
faqs.a: The letter must be created using your business letterhead and include specific details for your business and your personal details.

faqs.q: Who can use the sample text B?
faqs.a: Sample text B is for situations where you are a qualified accountant, registered tax agent, or registered BAS agent, and your client has asked you to register on their behalf for a grant, scheme, or support program administered by Service NSW.
